note: Keyless in-session translation. Scripture quoted verbatim from the Bíblia Livre para o Mundo (porbrbsl, ebible mirror por_bpm); only quote nesting was adjusted (inner double marks set as single) in Genesis 47:9 and Revelation 14:13. Self-rendered rows are Edwards' own re-personed adaptations (Job 7:8, 7:10; Ecclesiastes 7:1b) or an infinitive reworking (Matthew 6:33a).
